config.design: 8 adjective pairs x3 output contexts x4 states (positive/negative adjective crossed with absent/present not). Frozen H965 sentiment/negation directions; no fitting. All12 directed edges per quartet, with full-write, identity, both frozen rank1 projections and their complements at final-token MLP12.
config.native_gate: Per format and adjective cohort: >=4 quartets, >=.75 all-four binary correct, >=.5 pooled full-vocabulary intended group top1. No individual native-correct filtering. Failed cohorts remain diagnostics.
config.factors: a=+1 positive adjective,-1 negative; n=+1 plain,-1 not. Ideal binary valence=a*n is an operational expectation, not a claim that linguistic negation always reverses evaluative polarity. In particular not bad can be weakly positive or neutral.
config.cohorts: First4 adjective pairs appear in H965 discovery; last4 adjective pairs absent from H965 task-bank examples. All directions frozen. Some familiar format A prompts deliberately overlap prior data; explicit overlap counts. Not the original reserved test.
config.interpretation: Hadamard decomposition of four writes separates lexical adjective (a), presence of not (n), and interaction (a*n). Interaction is a necessary signature of ideal valence reversal on this panel but is not sufficient evidence of a reusable negation operator.
config.fidelity: KL(full donor write patch||candidate), relative to native baseline; projection coefficient uses true donor delta. Counterfactual span adequacy only; no deployable encoder or unsupervised-manifold claim.
